environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the stream processor with default service account. Container runs as root with no seccomp profile. Environment variables include DATABASE_URL, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and other secrets. The HSM_SIGNING_KEY_URI points to a SoftHSM2 instance running as a sidecar with PKCS#11 socket mounted at /var/run/softhsm.sock. The Kafka topic accepts messages from any authenticated producer in the cluster. No input validation middleware or schema registry enforcement on the topic.
